propositions: Pushes to the tickets branch should not trigger any CI workflows; the branch contains no code and auto-pushes occur on every rebar write (comment, edit, claim, close)
Four workflow files (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must append 'tickets' to their on.push.branches-ignore lists alongside existing feature/** and main exclusions
A new enumerating test must verify that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ push-matches the tickets branch, and that the test fails if a future bare push: trigger is added

Documentation must warn adopters that configuring CI on all branches turns every ticket write into a workflow run; guidance belongs in docs/concurrency.md (canonical), with cross-links in docs/user-guide.md and docs/config.md
Scheduled workflows (reconcile-bridge */20, verify-identity 53 */6, test 41 */6, optionality 47 */6, prompt-eval weekly Monday) must remain byte-identical and unaffected by the change
gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only and not be converted to any branch-filter-based trigger
